title: Neira et al. (2026), ecological groups and model source
supports: PDF4 Table1 supplies operative membership; Table3/PDF6 supplies printed basic inputs. Canonical accepted precision/defaults are distinct. S1–S7 were not acquired.

title: Sea Around Us regional catch and accepted classic coefficients
supports: All 218 exact labels, provider reporting names/function and saved TL/classic wet coefficients. 2019 landings denominator; no changes to raw catch or classic inputs.

title: Selected Chilean Patagonia 1980 canonical model JSON
supports: Protected model bytes; all 15 ecological groups. Source catch missing is not genuine zero. Runtime transformations are documented separately.

title: World Register of Marine Species API evidence, all named labels
supports: Accepted names, synonyms and classification for 213 queried labels; returned authoritative records retained. Provider ranks/historical reporting concepts also assessed, without rewriting catch labels.

title: WoRMS Fissurella cumingii, Aphia570478 spelling crosswalk
supports: Current accepted spelling cumingii and legacy cumingi identify the same taxon. Exact legacy catch label remains unchanged.

title: Smithsonian STRI, Seriolella violacea species account
supports: 65cm; coastal/near-coastal pelagic; 0–500m. Supports group 6 ecological extension with Medium confidence; genus Seriolella also contains named group 7 source species.

title: FishBase, Seriolella genus inventory
supports: Named source spelling cearulea is crosswalked to caerulea; genus scope includes source demersal species and pelagic violacea. Does not establish regional caught-mass weights.

title: FAO Cephalopods of the World Vol2, Dosidicus account pp301–304
supports: Large active epipelagic nekton, predatory role and fish/squid feeding. Partial ecological connection to represented mobile pelagic group 6; large body size, taxonomy and feeding role mismatch. Other source pools explicitly compared.

title: FAO Cephalopods of the World Vol2, Doryteuthis gahi account p88
supports: Patagonian shelf squid with shelf/near-bottom movements; differs from jumbo oceanic squid. Full catalogue too large for web parser; indexed account used with local provider/authority metadata.

title: Alegre et al. (2014), jumbo-squid trophic study
supports: Primary field study supports active predatory nekton role and fish/squid interactions. Does not establish mapping or biomass allocation by itself.

title: IFOP public sampling catalogue and age-composition search
supports: Available sample counts do not establish caught-mass proportions for <3/≥3-year Hoki in whole Humboldt 2019. Exact consulted URLs and limitation retained. Source 1980 landings proxy remains Medium.

title: Complete candidate catches, biomass and adopted split evidence
supports: All 218 taxa and every candidate retained. Missing candidate catches invalidate whole-set catch proxy; complete biomass fallback. Hoki uses 0.006/0.062 and 0.056/0.062 historical catch split.

title: Complete taxon audit and source-based candidate comparisons
supports: Membership and allocation components, all 16 source/recipient candidates including unfished groups; positive analogue connections, alternatives and assumptions. Overall confidence is the weaker component.

title: Exact saved GE, TE and With Egestion matrix inspection
supports: All 48 per-source entries in each method and full16×16 flow/equation matrices independently inspected. No negative/non-finite SPPR; exact scoped coefficient reconciliation. All overall WARN.

title: Source Figure1 reconstruction and two overlap denominators
supports: 35 nmi means offshore distance, not fixed longitude. Approximate 3–4 km source map plus 1:50m land; trace 194166km² vs reported 290000. A 7–11%, B 60–95%, low confidence; old rectangle inconsistent.

title: Source review, accepted runtime and scientific limitations
supports: Paper/canonical/runtime layers; temporal/geographic limitations and weak-analogue exposure. Shared metadata/map/browser integration pending coordinator.
